title: fix(console): first-run checklist counts like its progress, names Setup per language, folds to one line
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuEwfVd7uXPuit61egsUgNQ6)_
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWpxtdkmztBUeYCva3

Fixes #35417

Clause-②: yes (widening) — @object-ui/i18n adds console.firstRunChecklist.showDoneSplit; nothing removed
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在首页看到的「完成初始设置」卡片：已完成数与进度不再对不上，文案里的英文 Setup 换成各语言的「系统设置」叫法，只剩一两项时整张卡收成一行。
- 属于「控制台核心业务操作体验」专题，解决首页初始设置清单数字矛盾、中英混杂、少量剩余项仍占首屏的问题。
- 出错时只影响管理员首页这张清单的显示，不改任何设置、不写数据，可直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

1. **Done count matches the progress line.** The progress line counts the required rows alone (optional rows are kept out by the existing mail-optional ruling); the control that unfolds the done rows counted every done row, so a managed environment read "6 of 7 done" above "Show completed (8)". A new pure function `checklistDoneCount` in `firstRunChecklistLogic.ts` splits the done rows into required and optional. Once an optional row is done the control reads "Show completed (6 required · 2 optional)" (zh 「显示已完成的项（必做 6 · 可选 2）」); with none done it reads as before ("Show completed (6)"). New key `console.firstRunChecklist.showDoneSplit` in all eleven packs, translated.
2. **No English "Setup" in the checklist copy.** The three checklist strings that named Setup (`description`, `aiProvider.doneSettings`, `connectAssistant.todo`) now use the Setup app's own translated label from platform-objects' app translations: zh-Hans 系统设置, zh-Hant 系統設定, ja セットアップ, ko 설정, es Configuración, pt-BR Configuração, fr Configuration, ru Настройка (as «в разделе «Настройка»»), ar الإعداد. en and de keep "Setup", which is their label. No other "Setup" in the locale files is touched.
3. **One line when two rows or fewer are left.** Above the page (`top` placement), when `drawsOneLine` holds (1 or 2 drawn rows not done, optional included), the card draws one line: title, progress, each remaining row's title with a Set button, and the close button; no description, no done rows, no unfold control. It wraps (flex-wrap) at narrow widths. A localization row's Set opens the full card with that row's editor (`setEditing`), and the card folds back to the line when the editor closes (Cancel or a confirmed save). Every other row's Set opens the page its row already links to. The phone placement (`afterApps`) keeps its own fold, unchanged. No row, completion rule or write changes. The module docblock describes the one-line form.

## Tests

<details><summary>Console checklist suites (3 files)</summary>

`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run` on `FirstRunChecklist.test.tsx`, `firstRunChecklistLogic.test.ts`, `firstRunChecklistProfile.test.ts`: Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 109 passed (109), at d173c3c3.

New top-level describes in the shared harness `FirstRunChecklist.test.tsx`:
- done control counts required and optional apart: managed, two optional done, "3 of 6 done" with "Show completed (3 required · 2 optional)" and the zh form; CONTROL self-hosted with no optional done keeps "Show completed (2)".
- one-line form: one row left draws title, progress, the row and its Set, the close button, with no description, no toggle and no detail line; Set opens the full card with the editor and Cancel folds it back; two rows left with a link row (href kept, label Set) and close hides it; CONTROL three rows left draws the full card; CONTROL phone placement keeps its fold; zh label.
- locale pin: every non-en/de pack's three strings carry its Setup label and no "Setup"; the pack roster is asserted complete; CONTROL en/de keep "Setup".

Logic file: `checklistDoneCount` on the managed 6-of-7 + 2-optional case (progress 6/7, count 6 + 2) with a CONTROL; `drawsOneLine` at 1, 2, 3 and 0 rows left.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (committed fix first, restored by blob hash)</summary>

- `drawsOneLine` body replaced by `return false;` (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, anchor 1 to 0, blob 25f225bf79eb to 25e09c72b936): 4 failed, 96 passed; restored, blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- the split branch condition `: doneCount.optional > 0` replaced by `: false`: 1 failed (the managed split pin), 73 passed; restored, blob equals HEAD.
</details>

<details><summary>Wider console and i18n runs</summary>

- The six console App/FormPage suites that mount the checklist, plus all of `apps/console/src/pages/settings/`: Test Files 49 passed (49), Tests 483 passed (483).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check` and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/` (includes all-locales key parity): Test Files 105 passed (105), Tests 1957 passed, 13 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check`: exit 0, 0 errors (the console tsconfig lists both edited test files).
- eslint over the 4 console files and the 11 locale packs: 18 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The one-line form's Set label is `console.firstRunChecklist.set` for every row, as the card asks ("项名 + 「设置」按钮"), so a link row such as Invite colleagues reads Set there and keeps its own action label in the full card.
- The one-line form shows the Optional mark next to an optional row (for example mail), so a reader is not told an optional row is required.
- The one-line state is derived, not stored: a Set on a localization row opens the full card only while its editor is open.
- No before/after screenshot was taken.

## Verification

Read first: `FirstRunChecklist.tsx` (the one-line branch before the full card, and the done toggle label), `firstRunChecklistLogic.ts` (`checklistDoneCount`, `drawsOneLine`), the zh-Hans pack's `firstRunChecklist` block.

Two-minute check: run `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/FirstRunChecklist.test.tsx`; expect all tests passed, including the "folds to one line" and "its own label" describes.
